title: Operation Manager - Backend Confectionery
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Operations Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of our Confectionery Division. The candidate will be responsible for managing production, inventory, quality, manpower, procurement coordination, dispatch, and overall operational efficiency while ensuring that products are delivered on time and meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

\* Manage and supervise the overall day-to-day operations of the confectionery division.

\* Plan and monitor production schedules based on sales demand, orders, and inventory requirements.

\* Ensure smooth coordination between production, procurement, stores, sales, and dispatch teams.

\* Monitor the availability and consumption of raw materials, packaging materials, and finished goods.

\* Maintain optimum inventory levels and minimize wastage, expiry, and stock losses.

\* Ensure compliance with quality, hygiene, food safety, and operational standards.

\* Monitor production output, productivity, wastage, and operational costs.

\* Supervise and manage production and support staff, including manpower allocation and shift planning.

\* Ensure proper maintenance and efficient utilization of production machinery and equipment.

\* Coordinate with the purchase team for timely procurement of raw materials and packaging materials.

\* Monitor batch production, stock movement, dispatch, and delivery schedules.

\* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective and preventive measures.

\* Maintain proper operational records, reports, stock statements, production reports, and MIS.

\* Work closely with the management to achieve production targets, sales requirements, and profitability goals.

\* Develop and implement SOPs to improve operational efficiency and standardization.

\* Monitor vendor and supplier performance and coordinate for timely resolution of operational issues.

\* Ensure proper housekeeping, cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards across the production and storage areas.

\* Handle customer/order-related operational requirements and ensure timely fulfillment.

\* Conduct regular operational reviews and provide reports to senior management.

\* Identify opportunities for cost reduction, process improvement, and productivity enhancement.

\* Required Skills

\* Strong knowledge of confectionery/food production operations.

\* Excellent operations and people-management skills.

\* Knowledge of inventory management and production planning.

\* Good understanding of quality control and food safety practices.

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

\* Ability to manage multiple teams and coordinate across departments.

\* Good knowledge of MS Excel and MIS reporting.

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills.

\* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

\* Strong leadership, decision-making, and organizational skills.

\* Knowledge of production machinery, maintenance coordination, and process improvement will be an advantage.

Educational Qualification

\* Bachelor's degree in Operations Management, Food Technology, Hotel Management, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

\* Relevant experience in the confectionery, bakery, FMCG, food production, or hospitality industry will be preferred.

Pay: ₹24,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Web Development and Designing Intern
description:
The Opportunity: Mentorship over Meetings

Join our team on-site for an intensive, hands-on internship designed to turn students into professional developers. We don’t do "shadowing"—you will be building, breaking, and deploying real-world e-commerce solutions from day one.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can send their resume or application details to:

* Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders in a hybrid work model to refine requirements prioritize backlog items and deliver incremental value through well scoped technical solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across application integration and analytics layers and implement durable fixes and preventive measures that enhance system stability and user satisfaction.
* Contribute reusable components technical documentation and coding standards that improve developer productivity and knowledge sharing within the commerce engineering team.
* Align technical solutions with broader company goals by enabling efficient ecommerce operations that support sustainable economic growth and a better buying experience for society.
* Integrate optional supply chain management and multi channel capabilities when required to streamline order fulfillment flows and provide consistent experiences across digital touchpoints.

**Qualifications**

* Demonstrate strong proficiency with SAP Commerce and SAP Hybris platforms including configuration customization and extension development for complex ecommerce scenarios.
* Show hands on expertise in CI CD concepts and practical pipeline implementation using Jenkins or similar tools to automate build test and deployment stages for application changes.
* Exhibit advanced skills in Selenium with Java for designing maintainable automated test suites that validate core ecommerce journeys and key system integrations.
* Possess solid experience using Postman and PostMan Tool for API design review and testing including parameterization environment management and result analysis.
* Understand JSON structures and serialization in depth to support integration design data modeling and troubleshooting of service communication in distributed systems.

* Bring working familiarity with Google Analytics including event tracking goal configuration and reporting to support data driven enhancements to customer journeys.
* Ideally have exposure to supply chain management and multi channel domains to better understand order lifecycle requirements and omnichannel customer expectations.
